name: Lemon Oregano Chicken, Feta Cauliflower Mash & Cucumber-Tomato Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise; slice crosswise into half-moons. Halve tomatoes. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Fill a large pot with about 1-inch of hot water (from the tap); cover and place over high heat.
Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Roughly chop into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add cauliflower, reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
While the cauliflower is cooking, pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle chicken with oil and season with spices on both sides; arrange in a single layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil the chicken for 5 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, trim and thinly slice lemon.

Remove baking sheet from the oven. Using tongs, flip the chicken and place a lemon slice on top of each thigh. Return to the oven and continue to broil until chicken is golden brown and cooked through, 5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
When the cauliflower is tender, drain in a colander. Working in batches if necessary, place cauliflower, feta, cream, oil, and spices in a blender; purée until smooth.
To serve, divide chicken, salad, and cauliflower mash between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
